name: wechat-editorial-planner
description: Plan an evidence-based editorial calendar for the following week using subscribed WeChat accounts.

displayDescription.zh: 根据已订阅参考公众号的近期文章安排下周选题，按主题与发文频率给出写作角度、推荐理由与原文。
displayDescription.en: Build next week’s editorial calendar from subscribed reference accounts, with tailored angles, publication dates and attributed sources.

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 根据我的参考公众号，帮我排出下周的选题，每天一篇。
defaultInitPrompt.en: Plan one story per day for next week using my reference accounts.

quickPrompts.zh: 根据我的参考公众号，帮我排出下周的选题，每天一篇。
quickPrompts.en: Plan one story per day for next week using my reference accounts.

quickPrompts.zh: 围绕我指定的主题排下周选题，每篇给出推荐理由和参考原文。
quickPrompts.en: Plan next week around my chosen topic with reasons and original sources.

quickPrompts.zh: 下周只发三篇，帮我挑三个不同的选题并安排日期。
quickPrompts.en: Choose three distinct stories for next week and schedule their dates.
